title: Steady tracks
summary: Follow two vessels on fixed tracks and explore the encounter from different perspectives.

steps.title: Establish the scene
steps.body: Two synthetic vessels follow fixed tracks. Start in the overview, then use the bridge camera to compare perspectives. This is a player demonstration, not a navigational exercise.

steps.title: Observe relative motion
steps.body: Watch how the apparent position of the other vessel changes. Toggle the track overlay to connect the 3D view with the route geometry.

steps.title: Change your perspective
steps.body: Select either vessel and switch to Bridge. The camera follows its position and heading. Pause at any instant to inspect the scene.

steps.title: Review the encounter
steps.body: Scrub back to an earlier moment. The same time always produces the same vessel positions. Rule explanations will be added after the source material is reviewed.
